notes.title: Dart Racer update 2.7.0: Galaxy Cup!
notes.notes:
Another major feature is in, Galaxy Cup!



Win the 3 race cup by accumulating the most points, no restarts! 



Changes:

- added Galaxy Cups! 2 are currently available, more to come

- AI tweaks

- various polish and bug fixes



Happy racing playtesters!

notes.title: Dart Racer update 2.6.0: Revamped Dart progression!
notes.notes:
This long in the works revamps Dart progression! 



Completing races now rewards currency that you can spend to unlock and upgrade Dart parts. This is another step towards Galaxy Cup! 


That update took a while to develop... Future ones will comes faster, the plan is for 2-3 updates per month. Next up are new tracks! 



2.6.0 Changes:

- added currency rewards for completing races

- rebalanced dart parts

- tweaked dart handling

- ai dart tweaks

- adjusted sky track f

- polished sky map environment

- various polish and bug fixes



Happy racing playtesters!

notes.title: Demo update 2.2.1!

notes.title: Major update 2.2.0 just in time for VR Fest!
notes.notes:
Major update version 2.2.0!

Changes:
- New environment: Cloud City
- New endurance race in Cloud City
- Reworked Dart steering, added drifting for tight corners
- Added race intro cinematics
- Added and updated boost effects
- Punch to boost/drift
- Many QoL changes

More to come!

notes.title: Demo update 2.1.0!
notes.notes:
The demo was updated to version 2.1.0!

- Added split and lap times differences, easy way to see if you did better!
- Darts are no longer bound by gravity! Added side paths in few tracks as a test. Additionally driving should feel smoooooth
- Updated Dart dashboard, now is prettier!
- Laser/pointer should match expected direction, less confusing maybe?
- Other tweaks and fixes

[previewyoutube=VgWjz4EIxdU;full][/previewyoutube]

More to come!
